trap.label: how long + presente
trap.wrong: How long do you use this app? I use it since 2018.
trap.right: How long have you used this app? I have used it since 2018.
trap.why: Em português perguntamos “há quanto tempo você usa?” no presente. Em inglês, duração até agora exige Present Perfect (have used).

fix.right: I have been here since 9 o'clock.

rewrite.prompt: Faça a pergunta: “You have used it for two years.” (How long)
rewrite.answer: How long have you used it?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado simples com last year: “Have you been to Paris?”
rewrite.answer: Did you go to Paris last year?
